items.title: Where the fabric comes from
items.excerpt: Estate sales, Goodwill, friends’ closets and a kimono shop in Japan.
body: The fabric comes from all over the place: estate sales, Goodwill, friends’ closets, a second-hand kimono shop in Japan, and more.
I’ll never know the full story of each piece of fabric, but I love knowing it lived a life somewhere else — and that I get to give it a new one here.

items.title: The year I finally started
items.excerpt: Starting a slow-fashion brand alongside a full-time job.
body: 2025 was the year I finally started the business. I met so many good people as a market vendor.
I’m still figuring out how to balance a full-time job with sewing, which is why everything here happens slowly, in small batches.

items.title: What to do with all the scraps?
items.excerpt: Patches, leg warmers, tote panels — nothing gets wasted.
body: Every project leaves a pile of scraps. Some become patches, some become tote panels, some wait in a bin for the right idea.
If you have ideas — or a garment that needs a patch — come find me at the next market.
